title: Coastal Restoration Agencies
metaDescription: Support for agencies restoring coastal and brackish water systems with AI modeling, field-ready blueprints, and monitoring.
h1: Partners for coastal and brackish restorers
intro: We align with public agencies and nonprofits tasked with bringing coastal wetlands back online, adding AI where it de-risks decisions.
bullets: Evidence-first recommendations packaged for councils and boards
Community-safe rollout plans with transparent reporting
Training for local crews on sensors and stewardship

faq.question: Do you engage community groups?
faq.answer: Yes. We facilitate co-design sessions and translate technical results into public-friendly updates.

faq.question: How fast can you start?
faq.answer: Within 2-4 weeks with available data; faster if baseline sensing already exists.

title: Water Utilities & Operators
metaDescription: Sensor fusion and predictive maintenance for utilities managing complex water networks near coasts and wetlands.
h1: Monitoring and resilience for water utilities
intro: For utilities managing brackish interfaces and distribution assets, we provide monitoring, anomaly detection, and crew-ready runbooks.
bullets: Predictive maintenance signals for pumps and aerators
Quality drift alerts before compliance thresholds break
Audit trails that fit existing SCADA and IT policies
processSteps: Model tuning for local operating envelopes
Rollout with playbooks and escalation paths

faq.question: Can you deploy on-prem?
faq.answer: Yes. We support on-prem or hybrid deployments when cloud use is restricted.

faq.question: Will this replace crews?
faq.answer: No. We build assistive signals so crews can act sooner with clearer evidence.

title: Research Institutions
metaDescription: Collaborations with universities and labs studying biomimicry, water quality, and responsible AI for the environment.
intro: We partner with universities and labs on biomimicry structures, responsible AI evaluation, and field trials for restoration technologies.
bullets: Ethics and AI safety reviews for environmental deployments
Joint publications with transparent data handling
processSteps: Define research questions with measurable outcomes
Run phased pilots with safety guards

faq.question: Do you share datasets?
faq.answer: We share de-identified datasets and synthetic data where appropriate, respecting community and regulatory constraints.

faq.question: How do you handle dual-use risks?
faq.answer: We run risk reviews, limit model capabilities when necessary, and involve third-party advisors for critical deployments.
